title: DET-30-01 alert detail — five-stage correlated chain matched for one entity
event_type: SIEM correlation-rule alert view, DET-30-01 (failed logons → successful login → privileged token → suspicious process → external connection), all five stages joined for one account/session

callouts.explanation: The successful logon that follows the failed-logon burst within DET-30-01's window; logon_id is the entity key that stitches stages 2 through 4 together.
The suspicious process stage — a LOLBin invocation carried on Sysmon Event ID 1 specifically so ProcessGuid is available for the final join, per the §3.1 Blind Spot.
The entity key switches from logon_id to ProcessGuid exactly at the stage 4→5 boundary, since no single key spans the whole chain (Figure 30.2).
The final stage — an outbound connection from the flagged process — completing the chain within the configured window and producing the alert.

note: Conceptual/illustrative rendering of what a correlation-rule alert detail view showing all five matched stages would contain; not a captured screenshot of any actual SIEM product interface.
